name: Mark Gamba

bio.statement: Gamba's official legislative biography says he is one of the few renters serving in the Oregon Legislature.
bio.excerpt: Mark is one of the few renters currently serving in the Oregon State Legislature.

source.publisher: Oregon Legislature, Rep. Gamba member page

bio.statement: His official biography says climate change was the core reason he first ran for Milwaukie City Council.
bio.excerpt: Climate change was the core reason Mark first ran for Milwaukie City Council.

source.publisher: Oregon Legislature, Rep. Gamba member page

bio.statement: Ballotpedia lists photographer as Gamba's profession and describes his career as including commercial photography, photojournalism and small business ownership.
bio.excerpt: working as a commercial photographer, photojournalist, and small business owner

source.publisher: Ballotpedia

bio.statement: His voters' pamphlet statement lists Gamba's occupation as State Representative and small business owner, with a background as a National Geographic photographer.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: State Representative, small business owner Occupational Background: National Geographic Photographer

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 50

bio.statement: His pamphlet statement lists an AAS-CMC educational background and Milwaukie Mayor as his prior governmental experience.
bio.excerpt: Educational Background: AAS-CMC Prior Governmental Experience: Milwaukie Mayor

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 50

positions.statement: In a 2020 Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey for a congressional race, Gamba described climate change as the greatest threat humanity has faced.
positions.excerpt: Climate Change is the greatest threat humanity has ever faced.

source.publisher: Ballotpedia

positions.statement: In the same 2020 survey, Gamba said health care is a human right.
positions.excerpt: Health Care is a human right.

source.publisher: Ballotpedia

positions.statement: In his pamphlet statement, Gamba says climate change is his top priority and he will work on electrical transmission, faster clean-energy permitting through land use changes, and lower transportation emissions.
positions.excerpt: Climate change is the main reason Mark first ran for office. It remains his top priority. He will continue to drive policy to modernize how we build out our electrical transmission systems to enable a more rapid transition to cheap clean energy.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 50

positions.statement: Gamba says in his pamphlet statement that he has worked on affordable housing finance, renter protections and lower construction costs, and is now pursuing a public/private program to build affordable homes for working families to buy.
positions.excerpt: Mark has led the charge on reforming how we finance affordable housing, on renter protections, and on lowering the cost to construct new housing.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 50

positions.statement: His pamphlet statement says Gamba wants to address wealth inequality, citing the kicker and property tax limits as constitutional changes that benefit the richest Oregonians.
positions.excerpt: Mark is unafraid of taking on monied interests and pushing for the bold, transformative change we need.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 50
